dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sing for me, José, por favor!

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Oh? You want to hear my latest song? I call it Ode to a Morning Breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: ...I just need to tune my instrument.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: I am so sorry. I have had no audience to play for for so long that now my strings are a little... I'll sing for you next time.
